correctness.rationale: Independent symbolic reconstruction of the displayed Hermitian matrix gives the stated determinant and, on \(x_3=1\), the exact gradient Gröbner basis \(2x_0+x_2+1\), \(x_1^2+x_2\), \(4x_2^2-x_2-1\), yielding exactly four affine singular points. The projective infinity equations add exactly \(A,B,C,D\). At the seven claimed nodes the local Hessian is nondegenerate. At \(D\), the stated local polynomial has nondegenerate transverse quadratic form with determinant \(-17\); solving its transverse critical equations gives \(p=-2w^3/17-22w^5/289+\cdots\), \(q=-3w^3/17+w^5/289+\cdots\), and critical value \(h(w)=w^6/17+11w^8/289+\cdots\), so the germ is \(A_5\). The rank-two, real/semidefinite, and line-containment claims are exact algebraic checks and are consistent with the displayed matrix.
residual_risks: The result classifies only the displayed determinantal representation; it does not rule out another nodal realization of the same numerical triple.
